_role: THE FROZEN BINDING BETWEEN A ROUTE AND THE AUT-NNN THAT NAMES ITS DERIVED LEDGER ROW. `priority.build_entries()` reads its ids from here and from nowhere else. A route in this file keeps its id forever; a route absent from it is REFUSED rather than minted a number, because a silent mint is how the record was rewritten in the first place.
_why_this_file_exists: ⛔⛔ DERIVED IDS WERE POSITIONAL — `AUT-{index+1}` over routes sorted by id — SO ADDING ANY ROUTE SILENTLY REPOINTED EVERY ID AFTER IT (AUT-PD-215, measured 2026-09-03). Reproduced against the live graph: adding ONE route whose id sorts early moved 76 of 77 ids, taking AUT-073 from RT-TRIAL-REACH to RT-TRABECTEDIN-PPARG. ⛔ WHAT THAT BREAKS IS THE RECORD, NOT A BUILD: AUT-073 is the escalation trimcrae answered on 2026-09-01, and every commit message, receipt and cross-reference citing an AUT-NNN would come to mean something else with nothing red anywhere. `priority.merge()` repaired ids for anyone who read the ledger through it, but `build_entries()` is what MINTS them and three test modules plus every direct caller read it raw.
_how_to_add_a_route: Run `python3 research/autonomy/derived_ids.py --extend` after adding the route to systems/graph/routes.json, and COMMIT THE RESULT. It appends the new route with the next free ordinal and never renumbers an existing one. ⛔ Do NOT hand-edit a binding that already exists: that is the silent rewrite this file was created to stop, and `--check` fails the commit that does it.
_reading_it_the_other_way: Keyed by route because that is the lookup the scorer needs. The record a human wants is the inverse — what does AUT-073 mean — and `derived_ids.py --show AUT-073` answers it. The bijection is asserted by `--check`, so both readings are total.
_generated_from: research/autonomy/research-ledger.json `_derived` rows at commit 0bd5de4c4, which is the state every AUT-NNN already written into a receipt, a commit message or a test was written against. Nothing here is a new binding.
